# Kavel AI Photo Prompts

Kavel is a free AI video generator and AI image generator — 4K clips with sound, and images you can run without an account or a card. This package puts the best photo-edit prompts from [Kavel](https://www.kavel.ai) one trigger away, so you can paste a tested prompt into any image tool, or straight into Kavel, without retyping it.

### Installation

```
espanso install kavel-ai-prompts
```

### Usage

| Trigger | Expands to |
|---|---|
| `:kfigurine` | Collectible vinyl figurine prompt |
| `:kpet` | Royal Renaissance pet portrait prompt |
| `:k90s` | 1990s yearbook portrait prompt |
| `:khd` | Blur / noise removal and HD restore prompt |
| `:kpolaroid` | Retro instant print prompt |
| `:ksticker` | Die-cut sticker prompt |
| `:khair` | Hairstyle prompt (asks you for the style) |
| `:koutfit` | Outfit prompt (asks you for the outfit) |

Every prompt is written for image-to-image editing and keeps the same face or subject from your photo. These are the exact recipes Kavel runs behind its own generators, so they land the look on the first try instead of after ten rewrites.

Link triggers, if you want to run the prompt right away:

| Trigger | Opens |
|---|---|
| `:kavel` | [kavel.ai](https://www.kavel.ai) |
| `:kfig-link` | [AI Figurine Generator](https://www.kavel.ai/image/ai-figurine-generator) |
| `:kpet-link` | [AI Pet Portrait Generator](https://www.kavel.ai/image/ai-pet-portrait-generator) |
| `:khd-link` | [HD Photo Converter](https://www.kavel.ai/image/hd-photo-converter) |
| `:kdance-link` | [AI Dance Video Generator](https://www.kavel.ai/video/ai-dance-video-generator) |

Only edit photos you have the rights to.
